name: The Great Forest of Bak
description: Divided into Western and Eastern regions, it is the continent’s second-largest forest, safeguarded by an Imperial Decree. This protection was secured by Thalia in the Arena of Fate, defending the druids’ rights, which Baleroth used to showcase his supposed desire to enforce the Arena’s judgments, even against the Empire. Bak is no ordinary forest; it boasts healing ponds that cause plants to grow into exceptional beauty while ancient spells guard its core. This verdant sanctuary is home to the most extraordinary druidic circle of Tanares, devout followers of the Nature Spirits. Their deep connection with Bak offers them unique gifts: resurrection powers
